display_long_description:
Real Table Tennis brings the feel of a real table into your room. Every bounce, every brush of spin and every smash comes from a physics simulation running at 120 Hz — the ball behaves the way you expect because it follows the same rules as the real thing.

Rally freely in Practice mode, or step into Match mode with complete ITTF rules: proper service rotation, lets, deuce and best-of-3 to best-of-7 games.

The AI opponent doesn't cheat and doesn't play like a robot. Four difficulty levels — Easy, Normal, Hard and Pro — model human reactions and human mistakes. Force a fast, wide return and even a strong opponent can miss, just like a real player.

Designed for comfort: you stand at a virtual table matched to your real height, with no artificial locomotion. Calibrate your height and table position in seconds, then play a quick rally or a whole match.

Features:
• Physics-first ball simulation at 120 Hz — real spin, real bounces
• Practice mode for free play
• Match mode with full ITTF rules (11-point games, service rotation, lets, deuce)
• Four human-like AI difficulty levels
• Player height and table height calibration
• Comfortable standing play with no locomotion

New in 1.1.0: take the game online — challenge a friend to a 1v1 match over the internet or your local Wi‑Fi. Feel every ball strike through your controller with new impact haptics, plus refined physics for even truer spin and bounce.
